name: HSUS dogfighting tip line
notes: Humane World for Animals (formerly the HSUS) takes tips about organised dogfighting or cockfighting that is not happening right now: email animalfighting@hsus.org, as its current reward flyer says, or use its online report form. It offers a standing reward of $5,000 for information leading to a conviction for dogfighting or other animal fighting. If fighting is happening now, call 911.
section: Report animal abuse — WHO TO CONTACT

change_log.note: The HSUS is now Humane World for Animals. Its 2025 reward poster: "will pay you up to $5,000 for information leading to the arrest and conviction of a dogfighter or cockfighter. Email tips to animalfighting@humaneworld.org. Your identity will be protected." No phone number on it or on its animal fighting page. The email is added in the abuse workbook; the old 877-TIP-HSUS number is kept but labelled, and a person should ring it to see whether it is still answered.

A reviewer rang on 2026-11-04. (877) 847-4787 is not a tip line. Its current reward flyer (on humaneworld.org, read 2026-11-04) says "Email tips to animalfighting@hsus.org" and "$5,000 REWARD"; it also has an online report form.

change_log.from: animalfighting@humaneworld.org - https://www.humaneworld.org/en/issue/take-action-stop-animal-fighting - suspected organised dogfighting or cockfighting that is not in progress. The HSUS is now called Humane World for Animals, and its 2025 reward poster asks for tips by email; the old phone line, (877) 847-4787 (877-TIP-HSUS), is not on its current materials and may no longer be answered. Humane World offers a standing reward of $5,000 for information leading to a conviction for dogfighting or other animal fighting (its own page, read 2026-11-04). For fighting in progress call 911. Your identity is protected.
